source_specialization.source_units: BGG prints the component action in Planck units.
source_specialization.physical_bosonic_bridge: S_phys=M_P^2 S_BGG and Phi=M_P A=(T+iY)/sqrt(2), with M_P>0. Therefore M_P^2 partial(A)partial(Abar)=partial(Phi)partial(Phibar) and no sign changes.
source_specialization.coverage_units: The auxiliary and transformation formula inventory is checked in BGG-native units; Phase 16A does not invent a full dimensionful rescaling of every fermion and auxiliary.
source_specialization.matter: One neutral flat chiral coordinate K=A Abar, g_{A Abar}=1, Gamma=0, Kähler curvature=0, no vectors or gauging, W identically zero and every holomorphic or Kähler-covariant derivative of W zero. Spacetime derivatives of A remain independent.
source_specialization.bosonic_track: Set psi, psibar, chi, chibar, M, Mbar, b, F, and Fbar to zero only after their source availability is frozen. This is a velocity-sign specialization, not use of an auxiliary equation of motion.
source_specialization.geometry: e_m^a=diag(N,a,a,a), N>0, a>0, shift=0 on a compact positive fiducial cell V_0.
source_specialization.W_zero_rule: Use the additive kinetic action GRA.240/CPN.130 plus CPN.59. Omit the separately additive GRA.242/CPN.143 sector because W and all derivatives of W are identically zero. Do not use the G=K+ln|W|^2 reparametrization at W=0.

exact_convention_map.coordinate_time: dot=d/dt; a, N, adot, addot, Ndot, Tdot, and Ydot are real independent jet symbols before identities.
exact_convention_map.exact_domain: QQ(sqrt(2),sqrt(3)) extended by declared real symbols and rational functions on M_P V_0 a N nonzero; the temporary complex bridge uses QQ(i,sqrt(2),sqrt(3)) with conjugation i->-i and must project back to a real record.
exact_convention_map.scale_bridge: X=sqrt(6) M_P ln(a), dX=sqrt(6) M_P da/a.
exact_convention_map.connection_parent: In the bosonic specialization solve CPN.13, partial_n e_m^a+e_m^b omega_{n b}^a-(m<->n)=0, together with omega_{mab}=-omega_{mba}. CPN.15 is not a derivation parent.
exact_convention_map.curvature_parent: Store the source matrix component as R[n,m,b_lower,a_upper] from R_b^a=d omega_b^a+omega_b^c omega_c^a, preserving the BGG exterior-form order. Do not assign a multiple of Q.
exact_convention_map.scalar_contraction: Implement CPN.26 literally as e_a^n e_b^m (R_nm)^{ab}. The printed Lorentz order ab is semantic and must not be replaced by storage order or Hohl's ba order.
exact_convention_map.action_parent: Use M_P^2 times the BGG-native -calR/2 and the same-source scalar term -g g^{mn}partial_m A partial_n Abar.
exact_convention_map.endpoint_policy: Derive the raw second-order Einstein density first, then apply the single preregistered velocity-dependent endpoint B exactly once. Only after that define a first-order Hessian or Legendre transform.
exact_convention_map.frozen_hamiltonian_representative: Compare H_kin=N[-p_X^2+p_T^2+p_Y^2]/(2V_0a^3) in the frozen X,T,Y normalization immediately after B and before any additional dF/dt, real point map, densitization, or overall rescaling.
exact_convention_map.inertia_equivalence_only: Subsequent regular dF(q,t)/dt, derivative-free GL(3,R) point maps, and positive rescalings may witness inertia preservation but cannot repair the exact Hamiltonian.
